TS18048: `user` may be `undefined`
  at possibly-undefined.ts:9:10

     8 |   const user = users.find((u) => u.id === id);
  >  9 |   return user.name;
                  ^^^^
    10 | }

  `user` can be `undefined` here — `Array.find` returns `undefined` when no element matches. TypeScript won't let you read from it until the code rules that out.

  Fix: Narrow it first:
    if (user === undefined) {
      throw new Error("user is missing"); // or return a fallback
    }
    return user.name;
  Or, when a missing value may flow on as `undefined`:
  return user?.name;

  Original (deno check):
  │ TS18048 [ERROR]: 'user' is possibly 'undefined'.
  │   return user.name;
  │          ~~~~
  │     at file:///app/possibly-undefined.ts:9:10

error: Type checking failed.
